title: [BUG] Claude Code CLI Window Resize Shenannigans
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [x] Anthropic API - [ ] AWS Bedrock - [ ] Google Vertex AI - [ ] Other: - Claude CLI version: `1.0.65 (Claude Code)` - Operating System: `Win11` - Terminal: `pwsh 7.5.2` ## Bug Description If I resize my pwsh.exe window, this permanently happens: * It'll happen in Rider, Windows Terminal wrapper, pwsh.exe standalone - it doesn't matter. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Open claude with pwsh.exe 2. Resize the window -- possibly only when it's thinking, but not 100% sure ## Expected Behavior Expect (and adapt to) window resiizn ## Actual Behavior My entire viewport is just a mirrored dupe of the latest few lines over and over, making it unusable until I exit claude and go back. ## Additional Context
author: dylanh724
